prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your pet's official companion details to complete adoption.", "Sign Certificate & Continue"]
1: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We are assembling your pet's 3D desktop companion assets.", "Rendering pet assets...", "This usually takes 1-2 minutes.", "Finalizing Setup", "Your pet will appear on your desktop momentarily."]
2: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Scroll through to explore your virtual companion's personality traits and desktop interactions.", "Desktop pets react to your cursor and keep you company while working."]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption records and prevent loss of pet data."]
4: ["Signing in links your pet to your account so progress and custom pets are never lost when restarting."]
5: ["Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos", "For best custom pet generation, use well-lit photos showing your pet's face clearly without heavy filters.", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG under 10MB. Ensure one subject per photo."]
6: ["You will receive a desktop notification as soon as your pet moves onto your screen."]
7: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick action options."]
8: ["Welcome Home!", "Your desktop companion is ready. Take a moment to view basic controls."]
9: ["Choose Your Pet Path", "Includes Free Starter Toys & Treats"]
